scope.coverage: SourceTreeGenerator creates a valid one-module, one-function Generated C project. The test replaces its plan boundaryEvidence with 64 distinct short strings, leaving all other charged structural arrays empty for exactly 65 cumulative entries. It separately asserts source inventory, include-closure traversal, and declared dependency references remain below 64. At maximumDependencyEdges=65, the active scripted ACP repair acknowledges a replacement/readback, reaches an injected validator that checks every candidate source byte and profile/index/revision bindings, and stops at the expected identity-checked sentinel. The receipt records final-snapshot completion, two successful filesystem callbacks, and verified process/sandbox cleanup. At 64, graph admission returns the exact generated-C module-boundary structural-entry diagnostic before any harness dispatch or validator call; source and evidence bytes remain unchanged, no run or pending attempt is retained, and opening again at 65 succeeds.
